conflict: The recommended Journal Cover is built on a printed-magazine metaphor: paper cover, nameplate masthead with double rule, framed photo and back-issue stack styled as paper with offset shadows. Arena Nights has no paper layer.
adaptation: Keep the cover structure exactly (masthead, generated lead headline + standfirst, one Fortsätt CTA, arena photo with crest stamp, three briefs, back issues = other careers). Masthead becomes a broadcast title strap with a club-neon underline; headline set in Barlow Condensed italic; photo full-bleed with dark gradient; crest stamp glows in the club neon; back issues become glass cards, the active one glowing instead of an offset paper shadow.
preserved: Hierarchy (headline → Fortsätt → briefs → other careers), single-CTA interaction, 'since you last played' role, navigation to career/new career, mobile single-column cover.

conflict: Shares the Journal Cover concept with ENT-02 (back issues as paper issues).
adaptation: Same as ENT-02: back issues become glass career cards with crest, season, position; the current career glows in its own club neon, each card previews its own club accent.
preserved: Career list order, continue/load/delete actions, empty and error states.

adaptedName: Club first, contract last — living club card
conflict: The right-hand context column is a 'growing club journal page' (paper page with byline).
adaptation: Keep the three beats (Klubb · Manager · Kontrakt) and the growing context column, rendered as a living glass club card. When a club is picked, the whole wizard switches to that club's neon accent: the Club Identity System is shown at the moment of choice. Byline becomes a manager tag; mandate becomes a board-goal strip.
preserved: Three-step structure, advanced world-settings drawer, sticky footer, progressive disclosure, mobile stepper.

adaptedName: Week Spine + hub rail in Arena Nights
conflict: No conflict, but note: choosing Arena Nights as identity does NOT switch the navigation to Arena's original top hub bar. The recommended navigation model (6-hub rail + Week Spine + Peek + Ctrl-K) is preserved and restyled.
adaptation: Rail and Week Spine on dark glass; today's day cell lit in club neon; match days in club primary with a neon top edge; active hub with neon inset bar.
preserved: Six hubs, merged destinations, Week Spine, Peek, Ctrl-K, mobile bottom bar.

adaptedName: Masthead top bar in Arena Nights
conflict: No conflict; recommended top bar (masthead + search + labelled Continue) is kept rather than Arena's original hub bar.
adaptation: Continue rendered as the neon primary with glow and dark ink label; search on glass.
preserved: Labelled Continue, save actions moved to menu, search/palette entry.

conflict: Recommended 'First-day handover' is a paper page ('Första dagen på jobbet').
adaptation: Keep the two-column handover (crest + headline + facts appearing one by one | rotating handball tip card) and the explicit 'Gå in på kontoret' button (no auto-jump after 3 s). Rendered on the arena-night background with the new club's neon, facts ticking in with a neon check. Differs from Alternative B 'Arena arrival' by keeping C's calm handover and tips.
preserved: No auto-jump, tips while loading, error recovery actions.

conflict: Today's Paper is a newspaper front page: nameplate with ears, serif lead headline, rules and columns on paper.
adaptation: Same front-page structure: masthead with the two ears (Förtroende · styrelsen | Rykte · manager, each with delta and reason) → lead story chosen from game state (8/12) + numbered 'Att avgöra' column (4/12) → match box, ladder ±2, around-the-league briefs. Arena treatment: broadcast strap masthead with neon ring meters, lead story as full-bleed hero with headline on the image, decisions with neon numerals, match box styled as a score bug.
preserved: Lead-story selection logic, numbered decisions with inline actions, dual meter semantics, Week Spine above, Peek on names, mobile order (lead → decisions → match → table).

conflict: Newspaper nameplate ('KLUBBJOURNALEN') with paper ears and club-colour rule.
adaptation: Title strap with the issue line; ears become neon ring meters (board confidence left, manager reputation right) with last delta and reason. Club-colour rule becomes a club-neon underline.
preserved: Two-meter concept (short-term club vs long-term career), issue/date line, reasons on deltas.

conflict: An editorial boxed 'Matchrutan' with serif headline.
adaptation: Same content order (headline + countdown, readiness line, opponent form, ladder ±2, opponent in Peek) in a glass card with a score-bug crest row.
preserved: Readiness line, opponent Peek, ladder slice, Förbered action.

conflict: 'Almanac section of the Club Journal' (printed almanac styling).
adaptation: Keep timeline + facts sidebar; honours as gold-glow markers on a neon timeline; supporters' mood with causes as chips; national windows still move to the calendar as pins.
preserved: Content model and the move of national windows to the calendar.

conflict: Club Journal is the club's paper front page (rules, serif quote, double-rule head).
adaptation: Same front-page order (header with identity facts → history strip of positions/honours → department briefs, board mood, economy KPIs, people). Arena treatment: neon club stripe (primary → neon), radial club glow behind the header, gold-glow honours, quote with neon edge.
preserved: History strip, department briefs with owners, board quote + dual meter, economy KPIs, links to Personal/Ekonomi/Styrelsen.

conflict: 'Öppna hela' opens an editorial portrait (headline sentence, prose identity, quotes).
adaptation: Peek drawer unchanged. Full page keeps headline sentence + identity + philosophy + squad/fixtures; headline in condensed display; prose split into short statements; unknown claims as blurred glass lines (fog of war).
preserved: Peek-first behaviour, knowledge tier, fogged unknowns, H2H.

conflict: Manager Biography relies on serif biography typesetting and a printed-chapter feel.
adaptation: Keep chapters, the single career reputation line with annotated causes, 'Nästa kapitel' job market and the quiet resign footer. Chapters as neon timeline nodes, trophies with gold glow, headline in condensed display.
preserved: Chapter structure, reputation line with reasons, dismissal as chapter break, dual meter.

conflict: A skeuomorphic shelf of season books (spines, covers).
adaptation: Keep shelf → open structure: a horizontal row of tall season cards (spine strip with year, position, honour star) that opens into a cover panel (4/12) + tabs (8/12). Cards use club neon of the club managed that season, so history shows your career's colours.
preserved: Per-season summary fields, open-book detail tabs (table, stats, matches, transfers).

conflict: Correspondence Desk uses a paper-desk metaphor: rotated letters, paper stack, serif headlines.
adaptation: Keep the desk structure: pinned 'Att göra' tray, threads grouped by entity, reader with chain rail. Letters become glass message cards (no rotation); the top item has a neon edge and glow; headlines in condensed display.
preserved: Inline resolution, threading by entity, chain rail (event → decision → consequence), filters, keyboard shortcuts.

conflict: Letter-style body with serif headline; 'Följd' stamp as an ink stamp.
adaptation: Message body in Barlow 15/1.55 for readability; chain rail as neon-linked nodes; 'Följd' becomes a glowing outcome badge + 'Sparat i karriärloggen'.
preserved: Chain rail, inline decisions with consequence preview, empty states.

conflict: Lead story with serif headline.
adaptation: Lead headline in condensed display over the photo's dark gradient; dated list and outlet chips unchanged.
preserved: Lead + dated list structure.

conflict: Quotes 'typeset into the transcript' and closing as an article.
adaptation: Transcript as broadcast captions with journalist/outlet tags; tone chips and 'Vem reagerar' meter rail unchanged; closing article becomes a recap card with the same 'Följder' box.
preserved: Question order, tone choice with preview, reaction rail, consequences logged.

conflict: Feature Profile is an editorial magazine profile (serif headline, double-rule header, framed paper portrait).
adaptation: Same two-column profile: words-first strengths/weaknesses, attribute groups with potential bars, development, season ledger, Peek variant. Portrait framed in a club-neon radial glow; header with neon underline; headline in condensed display.
preserved: Words before numbers, tab state in URL (spec), Peek variant, ability/potential band, mobile order.

conflict: 'Editorial scouting desk': reports as articles with bylines.
adaptation: Keep pipeline strip, report feed and ranked Kortlista. Report cards with scout tag (not byline), confidence ring, verdict with glow; selected shortlist row lit in club neon.
preserved: Ranges for uncertainty, single shortlist, Förbered bud flow into negotiation.

conflict: A 'paper-mode stepper' that flips to Floodlight for kick-off. In Arena Nights everything is already dark, so the paper→floodlight contrast disappears.
adaptation: Same three skippable steps (Truppen, Motståndaren, Planen). Steps sit on calm, desaturated dark glass; completing step 3 raises intensity: club neon floods the stage, the arena photo fades in and the walk-out starts. The signature transition becomes an intensity escalation instead of a light-mode switch.
preserved: ≤3 skippable steps, blocking counts, Swedish words instead of enums, 'Till avkast' footer.

conflict: Floodlight Sequence depends on the paper→Floodlight mode switch for its emotional payoff (it already fits B visually).
adaptation: Identical phases (walk-out → live with Bench Dock → timeout huddle → half-time → slutsignal) and the same score bug/Bench Dock. Phase intensity is expressed with neon: calm preparation, glowing live cards, neon score separator.
preserved: Phase structure, Bench Dock as the single decision place, manpower/suspension legibility.

conflict: Editorial Match Report is the club journal's match page (serif headline, journal styling).
adaptation: Same report order (headline + kicker → quote → what decided it / what it means → next step analysis → training → box score, ratings, shot map). Headline in condensed display, neon quote edge, next-step card glowing.
preserved: Absorbs ANL-05/MDY-04 (no circular content), analysis → training link, no xG.
